k: A Brooklyn kid made into the super soldier Captain America
st: Steve takes Erskine's serum, fights HYDRA as Captain America, and crashes in the ice, waking almost seventy years later.
Steve leads the Avengers against Loki and the Chitauri in the Battle of New York.
Steve uncovers HYDRA inside S.H.I.E.L.D., downs its helicarriers, and learns the Winter Soldier is Bucky.
Steve fights Ultron in Sokovia with the Avengers, then starts training a new team at the Avengers Facility.
Steve rejects the Sokovia Accords to protect Bucky, fights Tony, then breaks his allies out of the Raft.
Steve's team returns to fight Thanos's army in Wakanda, but Thanos snaps and half of all life turns to dust.
At the Avengers Compound, Steve and the survivors watch Fury's pager when Carol Danvers appears.
Steve leads the Time Heist, lifts Mjolnir against Thanos, then returns the Stones and stays in the past with Peggy.

k: Steve Rogers's best friend, a Howling Commando
The Winter Soldier, a brainwashed HYDRA assassin
A free man trying to make amends
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
A congressman and one of the New Avengers
tm: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
st: Bucky fights beside Steve with the Howling Commandos, then falls from a HYDRA train in the Alps.
Bucky returns as HYDRA's Winter Soldier, but pulls Steve from the river after their battle.
Framed for the Vienna bombing, Bucky fights beside Steve, then chooses to go back into cryo-sleep in Wakanda.
Shuri helps Bucky heal in Wakanda, where he wakes to a quiet life the children call the White Wolf.
Bucky gets a new arm and fights Thanos's army in Wakanda, then turns to dust in the Snap.
Restored, Bucky fights in the final battle and watches Steve hand his shield to Sam.
Pardoned, Bucky joins Sam against the Flag Smashers, breaks Zemo out to help, and makes amends for his past.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Now a congressman, Bucky helps Yelena's group face the Void and becomes one of the New Avengers.

k: An SSR agent who believes in Steve Rogers
An SSR agent underestimated by her bosses
st: Peggy trains Steve in Project Rebirth, fights HYDRA beside him, and hears his last call before the crash.
In 1945, Peggy and the SSR raid a HYDRA base in Austria and seize its strange artifacts.
Peggy secretly clears Howard Stark's name, faces Leviathan in New York, then Zero Matter in Los Angeles.
Brushed aside at the SSR, Peggy recovers the Zodiac alone, and Howard Stark brings her in to lead S.H.I.E.L.D.
In 1970, Steve glimpses Peggy at Camp Lehigh, and later he returns to the past to share his life with her.
In 1989, Peggy sits with Howard at S.H.I.E.L.D. when Hank Pym quits over his shrinking formula.
Elderly and losing her memory, Peggy welcomes Steve to her bedside in Washington.
Peggy dies in her sleep in London, and her niece Sharon speaks at her funeral.
Howard flies Peggy and Steve behind enemy lines, builds Steve's gear, and finds the Tesseract while searching for him.
Framed for selling his weapons, Howard goes into hiding and relies on Peggy to clear his name.
Howard pulls Peggy out of the SSR to help lead his new S.H.I.E.L.D.
At Camp Lehigh in 1970, Howard talks about fatherhood with a disguised Steve as his first child is on the way.
In old film reels, Howard tells young Tony that his greatest creation is him.
In 1989, Howard is at S.H.I.E.L.D. when Hank Pym punches Mitchell Carson and quits.
In 1991, the Winter Soldier kills Howard and Maria Stark and takes the super soldier serum from their car.

k: The SSR colonel in charge of Project Rebirth
st: Phillips doubts Steve, then backs Captain America after he frees the captured men of the 107th.

k: The scientist behind the super soldier serum
st: Erskine picks Steve for Project Rebirth, then is shot dead by a HYDRA spy right after the procedure.

k: Steve's unit: Dugan, Morita, Jones, Falsworth and Dernier
st: Freed from HYDRA by Steve, the soldiers form the Howling Commandos and hit HYDRA bases across Europe.
Dugan's Howling Commandos take Peggy on a mission into Soviet territory.

k: A Howling Commando in a bowler hat
st: Freed from HYDRA by Steve, Dugan joins the Howling Commandos and helps capture Arnim Zola.
In 1945, Dugan raids a HYDRA base in Austria with Peggy Carter and the SSR.
Dugan and his Howling Commandos join Peggy on a mission into Soviet territory.
Freed from HYDRA by Steve, Morita joins the Howling Commandos.
In 1945, Morita raids a HYDRA base in Austria with Peggy Carter and Dum Dum Dugan.
In 1991, Maria dies with Howard when the Winter Soldier attacks their car.
Captured by the Ten Rings, Tony builds a suit to escape, stops Obadiah Stane, and tells the world he is Iron Man.
Dying from palladium poisoning, Tony creates a new element and beats Vanko's drones at the Stark Expo.
Tony joins the Avengers and flies a nuke through the portal to stop the Chitauri.
Tony loses his home to the Mandarin's attack, exposes Aldrich Killian, and has the shrapnel removed from his chest.
Tony builds Ultron to protect the world, then helps the Avengers stop it in Sokovia.
Tony signs the Sokovia Accords and fights Steve, then learns Bucky killed his parents.
Tony fights Thanos on Titan and is stabbed, then watches Peter turn to dust.
Tony solves time travel for the Heist, then snaps Thanos's army away with the Stones and dies.
Pepper keeps Tony's life running and helps him expose Obadiah Stane.
Tony makes Pepper CEO of Stark Industries, and she survives the attack on the Stark Expo.
Pepper celebrates Stark Tower's clean energy with Tony before Coulson brings him the Avengers file.
Killian kidnaps Pepper and injects her with Extremis, and she kills him in the final battle.
At the Avengers Compound, Tony brings out the engagement ring Happy has kept for him since 2008.
Pepper and Tony talk about having a child before Bruce and Strange arrive in Central Park.
Pepper raises Morgan with Tony, joins the final battle in the Rescue armor, and is with him when he dies.

k: Tony's best friend, an Air Force officer
st: Rhodey finds Tony in the desert and later covers for him with the military and the press.
Rhodey takes one of Tony's suits to the Air Force and fights Vanko's drones as War Machine.
Rebranded as the Iron Patriot, Rhodey is captured by Killian's men and helps Tony save the President.
Rhodey joins the battle in Sokovia, then becomes one of the new Avengers.
Rhodey sides with Tony over the Accords and is badly hurt when Vision's blast hits him by mistake.
Walking with braces, Rhodey fights Thanos's army in Wakanda and survives the Snap.
Rhodey goes to Morag with Nebula for the Time Heist and fights in the final battle.
A Skrull named Raava has been posing as Rhodey, and the real Rhodes is freed from a Skrull prison when Gravik falls.

k: Head of security at Stark Industries
st: Happy drives Tony Stark around and keeps an eye on him.
Happy boxes with Tony, then drives Natasha into Hammer's facility and takes down a guard.
Now head of security, Happy tails Savin and is badly hurt in the Mandarin's bombing at the Chinese Theatre.
Happy watches over Peter Parker for Tony, misses his warnings, and moves the Avengers' gear out of Stark Tower.
Happy stays close to Pepper and Morgan and attends Tony's funeral.
Happy watches over Peter in Europe, helps him beat Mysterio, and starts dating May.
Happy helps May and Peter after Mysterio's reveal, then forgets Peter after Strange's spell.
Happy turns down Wade Wilson, a visitor from another universe, when he asks to join the Avengers.
In 1995, rookie agent Coulson helps Fury and Carol Danvers slip out of a S.H.I.E.L.D. lockdown.
Coulson approaches Tony and Pepper for S.H.I.E.L.D. and helps Pepper confront Obadiah Stane.
On his way to New Mexico, Coulson calmly stops a robbery at a gas station.
A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
Coulson takes charge of the S.H.I.E.L.D. site around Mjolnir and questions Thor.
Coulson and Sitwell send Tony Stark to spoil the Council's plan to recruit Emil Blonsky.
Coulson gathers the heroes, and Loki stabs him with the scepter, uniting the Avengers.
Brought back to life, Coulson leads a new S.H.I.E.L.D. team and rebuilds the agency as its Director.
Dying after a deal with the Ghost Rider, Coulson retires to Tahiti with May and spends his last days there.

k: A former spy working in space
st: In 1995, agent Fury teams up with Carol Danvers against the Kree, losing an eye to Goose.
Fury visits Tony Stark to talk about the Avengers Initiative.
Fury assembles the Avengers to stop Loki and defies the Council's order to nuke New York.
Fury survives a Winter Soldier attack, fakes his death, and helps Steve bring down HYDRA within S.H.I.E.L.D.
Fury sends a signal to Carol Danvers on his pager before he turns to dust.
Fury is revealed to be in space on a Skrull ship, with Talos posing as him on Earth.
Fury returns to Earth to stop Gravik's Skrull rebels, then leaves with his wife Varra for S.A.B.E.R.
From his S.A.B.E.R. station, Fury helps Carol, Monica and Kamala stop Dar-Benn.
In 1999, Yinsen is at the New Year's party in Bern where Tony brushes him off.
Held captive with Tony in Afghanistan, Yinsen helps him build the armor and dies buying him time to escape.
J.A.R.V.I.S. runs Tony's home and workshop and helps him build and fly the Iron Man suit.
Ultron attacks J.A.R.V.I.S., whose surviving code helps bring Vision to life.
J.A.R.V.I.S. lives in Vision's mind with Tony's other AIs, then deletes himself to save Vision from Paladin.
Tony picks F.R.I.D.A.Y. as his new AI after J.A.R.V.I.S. becomes part of Vision.
F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs Tony's time travel simulations at the lake house, and the model works.
F.R.I.D.A.Y. lives in Vision's mind with Tony's other AIs and helps him protect Tommy.
Tony's robots help in his workshop, and Dum-E hands him his old arc reactor just in time.
Dum-E and U live in Vision's mind as handymen alongside Tony's other AIs.
Christine sleeps with Tony, then shows him photos of Stark weapons in the hands of terrorists.
Christine covers the Stark Expo, where Justin Hammer shows off his drones.
Christine anchors WHIH Newsfront and reports on the world of heroes.

k: A scientist who turns into the Hulk
st: Hunted by General Ross, Bruce seeks a cure, then lets the Hulk out to stop the Abomination.
Bruce joins the Avengers, and the Hulk smashes Loki in the Battle of New York.
Bruce helps create Ultron and Vision, then flies off in a Quinjet as the Hulk.
The Hulk fights Thor as Sakaar's champion, then turns back into Bruce and helps fight Hela.
Thanos beats the Hulk, and Bruce warns Earth, then fights in Wakanda in the Hulkbuster armor.
Now Smart Hulk, Bruce joins the Time Heist and uses the Stones to bring back everyone lost in the Snap.
Bruce trains his cousin Jen after his blood gives her powers, then returns from Sakaar with his son Skaar.
Bruce helps Peter build an inhibitor, until Jean Grey makes him the Hulk and Spider-Man calms him down.

k: A scientist and Bruce Banner's love
st: Betty reunites with Bruce, helps him look for a cure, and stands up to her father, General Ross.
Betty visits her father with Sam Wilson after he turns himself in to the Raft.
Betty's boyfriend Leonard welcomes Bruce into his home, then tips off the army.

k: Odin's son, the God of Thunder
st: Banished to Earth without his powers, Thor proves worthy of Mjolnir again and stops Loki.
Thor comes to Earth for Loki, fights with the Avengers against the Chitauri, and takes Loki home.
Thor fights Malekith to save Jane and the Nine Realms, then turns down the throne of Asgard.
Thor fights Ultron, helps bring Vision to life, and leaves to learn about the Infinity Stones.
Thor loses Mjolnir to Hela, escapes Sakaar, and leads his people away as Asgard falls.
Thor survives Thanos's attack, forges Stormbreaker, and strikes Thanos, but not in the head.
Thor gets the Reality Stone in 2013, fights Thanos, then names Valkyrie king and leaves with the Guardians.
Thor faces Gorr with Jane, Valkyrie and Korg, loses Jane, and adopts Gorr's daughter Love.
Jane finds Thor in the New Mexico desert and falls for him as he learns to be worthy.
Jane absorbs the Aether, is taken to Asgard by Thor, and helps defeat Malekith in London.
In 2013, Rocket draws the Aether out of a sleeping Jane on Asgard.
Dying of cancer, Jane becomes the Mighty Thor, fights Gorr, and dies in Thor's arms before reaching Valhalla.

k: An astrophysicist and Jane Foster's mentor
st: Selvig helps Jane find Thor, then agrees to study the Tesseract for S.H.I.E.L.D.
Under Loki's control, Selvig opens the portal, then shows Natasha how to close it.
Shaken by Loki's control, Selvig helps Jane and Darcy stop Malekith's Convergence.
Selvig helps Thor reach the Water of Sights.
Selvig checks in on Jane as she battles cancer.
Darcy tases Thor when he first stumbles out of the desert.
Darcy helps Jane and Selvig use their gadgets to fight Malekith in London.
Darcy spots the Westview broadcast for S.W.O.R.D., gets trapped in the Hex, then helps stop Hayward.
Darcy keeps Jane company as she battles cancer.
Ian helps Darcy and Jane fight Malekith in London and ends up kissing Darcy.

k: King of Asgard, Thor and Loki's father
st: Odin banishes Thor to Earth, falls into the Odinsleep, and wakes in time to save his sons.
Grieving Frigga, Odin refuses to help Thor go after Malekith.
Found in Norway after Loki's spell, Odin says goodbye to his sons and fades away.

k: Queen of Asgard, Thor and Loki's mother
st: Frigga watches over Odin in his sleep while Loki takes the throne.
In 2013, Frigga sees that Thor has come from the future and urges him to be who he is.
Frigga protects Jane from Malekith and is killed by Kurse.
Heimdall defies Loki to help Thor, and is frozen before he breaks free.
Heimdall helps Thor sneak Jane off Asgard.
Heimdall hides Asgard's people from Hela, then helps them flee with Thor.
Heimdall sends the Hulk to Earth with the last of his power, and Thanos kills him.

k: An Asgardian warrior and Thor's friend
st: Sif and the Warriors Three defy Loki to bring Thor home and fight the Destroyer.
Sif guards Asgard and helps Thor break Loki out to go after Malekith.
Sif comes to Earth to capture the Asgardian Lorelei, and later returns to hunt a Kree warrior.
Badly hurt fighting Gorr, Sif warns Thor, then trains New Asgard's children with Valkyrie.

k: Fandral, Hogun and Volstagg, Thor's comrades
st: The Warriors Three fight beside Thor on Jotunheim, then defy Loki to bring Thor home.
The Warriors Three help Thor end the war on Vanaheim and smuggle Jane off Asgard.
Hela kills Fandral, Volstagg and Hogun when she takes Asgard.

k: Thor's brother, an ally in a crisis
A Loki variant working with the TVA
st: Freed by Thor to avenge Frigga, Loki helps fight Malekith, fakes his death, and takes Odin's throne in disguise.
Exposed by Thor, Loki ends up on Sakaar, then returns to help save Asgard's people from Hela.
Loki hands Thanos the Tesseract to save Thor and dies trying to kill him.
In 2012, a captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Time Heist and vanishes.
Taken by the TVA, this Loki helps hunt the variant Sylvie, and together they find He Who Remains.
Slipping through time, Loki takes He Who Remains's place, holding the timelines together at the end of time.

k: A former Valkyrie, now a scrapper on Sakaar
st: A drunk scrapper on Sakaar, Valkyrie sells Thor to the Grandmaster, then joins him to fight Hela.
Valkyrie leads Asgardians into the final battle, and Thor names her king of New Asgard.
Valkyrie fights Gorr with Thor and Jane, is wounded, and later trains New Asgard's children.
Valkyrie arrives by the Bifrost to give Carol's Skrull refugees a home in New Asgard.
Korg befriends Thor in the gladiator pits and leads a revolt on Sakaar.
Korg plays video games with Thor in New Asgard, then fights in the final battle.
Korg narrates Thor's story, survives as a head when Zeus shatters his body, and starts a family with Dwayne.

k: An insect gladiator and Korg's friend
st: Miek joins the revolt on Sakaar and flees with Thor and the Asgardians.
Miek lives in New Asgard with Korg.

k: King of the dwarves of Nidavellir
st: Eitri, the last of the dwarves, helps Thor forge Stormbreaker at Nidavellir.
After serving Hela as her executioner, Skurge turns on her army and dies defending Asgard's people.

k: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and expert archer
st: Clint takes aim at Thor from a perch as he fights his way to Mjolnir.
Loki takes control of Clint, until Natasha knocks him free and he fights with the Avengers.
Clint hides the team at his secret family farm, helps save Sokovia, then retires.
Clint comes out of retirement for Steve, is locked in the Raft, and is broken out by Steve.
After his family vanishes, Clint becomes Ronin, then joins the Time Heist and loses Natasha on Vormir.
In New York at Christmas, Clint teams up with Kate Bishop against the Tracksuit Mafia and Kingpin.
Laura hosts the Avengers at the Barton farm while expecting her third child.
Laura vanishes in the Snap with her children, and returns to Clint after the final battle.
Laura helps Clint by phone, and he brings her back her old S.H.I.E.L.D. watch.
Lila meets the Avengers on the Barton farm.
Lila practices archery with Clint before she vanishes in the Snap, and returns after the final battle.
Lila spends Christmas with her father.
Cooper meets the Avengers on the Barton farm.
Cooper vanishes in the Snap and returns after the final battle.
Cooper spends Christmas with his father.
Laura gives birth to Nathaniel, named after Natasha.
Nathaniel vanishes in the Snap and returns after the final battle.
Nathaniel spends Christmas with his father.
Hill serves as Fury's deputy aboard the Helicarrier during Loki's attack.
Hill helps Steve and Fury reprogram the helicarriers, then goes to work for Tony Stark.
Hill runs operations for the Avengers and helps evacuate Sokovia.
Hill turns to dust beside Fury as he sends his pager signal.
Restored, Hill attends Tony Stark's funeral.
Hill helps Fury hunt the Skrull rebels in Moscow, and Gravik, disguised as Fury, shoots her dead.
Blake hunts Benny and Claire after they steal a Chitauri gun, then recruits them to S.H.I.E.L.D.
Deathlok breaks Blake's spine, and he later turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. as the leader of the anti-Inhuman Watchdogs.
Undercover as Natalie Rushman, Natasha watches Tony for S.H.I.E.L.D. and storms Hammer's facility.
Natasha brings Bruce in, frees Clint from Loki's control, and closes the portal with the scepter.
Natasha helps Steve expose HYDRA, dumps S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets online, then faces Congress.
Natasha grows close to Bruce, fights Ultron in Sokovia, then trains new Avengers with Steve.
Natasha signs the Accords, then lets Steve and Bucky escape and becomes a fugitive.
On the run, Natasha reunites with her Red Room family and frees the Widows from Dreykov.
Natasha fights Thanos's army in Wakanda with Steve's team.
Natasha keeps the Avengers going for five years, then gives her life on Vormir for the Soul Stone.

k: A Sokovian with powers from the scepter
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
st: Wanda turns on Ultron, fights to save Sokovia, loses Pietro, and joins the new Avengers.
A mission in Lagos goes wrong, and Wanda sides with Steve, is locked in the Raft, and is broken out by him.
Wanda destroys the Mind Stone, but Thanos reverses time, kills Vision, and she turns to dust.
Restored, Wanda nearly beats Thanos in the final battle.
Grieving, Wanda traps Westview in a sitcom world with Vision and their sons, then lets it go.
Corrupted by the Darkhold, Wanda hunts America Chavez, then brings Mount Wundagore down on herself.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Pietro turns against Ultron, helps evacuate Sokovia, and dies shielding Clint and a child.

k: A synthezoid born from J.A.R.V.I.S. and the Mind Stone
st: Vision is born with the Mind Stone, lifts Mjolnir, and helps destroy Ultron.
Vision sides with Tony, but his blast hits Rhodey by mistake.
Vision hides with Wanda in Scotland until Thanos tears the Mind Stone from his head.
In Westview, the Vision Wanda made fades away, while a rebuilt white Vision regains his memories and flies off.
Living in Edinburgh, Vision is hunted by the bounty hunter Paladin and rescues Tommy, who claims to be his son.
To stop the killer Jocasta, Vision lets Ultron take control, and Ultron locks him out and leaves with Tommy.

k: A geneticist who grows synthetic tissue
st: Ultron uses the scepter on Helen Cho to build his new body, and she warns the Avengers.

k: A Ravager who calls himself Star-Lord
Leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy
st: Raised by Ravagers since 1988, Peter steals the Orb, forms the Guardians, and stops Ronan.
Peter meets his father Ego, kills him to save the galaxy, and mourns Yondu.
Peter learns Thanos killed Gamora and lashes out on Titan, then turns to dust.
Restored, Peter fights in the final battle and looks for the 2014 Gamora.
Peter and the Guardians travel with Thor before parting ways.
Mantis and Drax bring Kevin Bacon to Knowhere for Peter, and Mantis reveals she is his sister.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Peter saves Rocket, names him captain, and returns to Earth to see his grandfather.
Gamora betrays Ronan to sell the Orb, and joins the Guardians to stop him.
Gamora fights Ego with the Guardians and makes peace with Nebula.
Captured by Thanos, Gamora gives up the Soul Stone's location, and he sacrifices her on Vormir.
A Gamora from 2014 turns on her father, fights in the final battle, and slips away.
Now a Ravager, the 2014 Gamora helps save Rocket, then goes back to the Ravagers.

k: A warrior seeking revenge on Ronan and Thanos
st: Drax attacks Gamora in prison, wants Ronan dead, then joins the Guardians.
Drax befriends Mantis and fights Ego.
Drax fights Thanos on Titan and turns to dust.
Restored, Drax fights in the final battle.
Drax and Mantis kidnap Kevin Bacon as a Christmas gift for Peter.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Drax helps save Rocket and stays on Knowhere to raise the rescued children.

k: A genetically altered raccoon and bounty hunter
st: As a young test subject, Rocket befriends other experiments and escapes the High Evolutionary.
Rocket and Groot hunt Peter for a bounty and end up forming the Guardians.
Rocket steals Ayesha's batteries and bonds with Yondu before he dies.
Rocket helps Thor forge Stormbreaker and survives the Snap in Wakanda, losing Groot.
Rocket joins the Time Heist and fights in the final battle.
Gravely hurt, Rocket is saved by the Guardians, frees the High Evolutionary's captives, and leads the new team.

k: A new Groot grown from a cutting
st: Groot shields his friends with his branches when the ship crashes and dies, and a cutting becomes a new Groot.
Baby Groot gets into small adventures of his own.
Baby Groot dances through a fight and helps blow up Ego's core.
A teenage Groot gives his arm for Stormbreaker's handle, then turns to dust.
Restored, Groot fights in the final battle.
Grown up, Groot helps rescue Rocket and stays with the new team.

k: Leader of the Ravagers who raised Peter
st: Yondu hunts Peter for the Orb, then leaves with a fake that Peter swapped in.
Freed from Taserface's mutiny, Yondu helps the Guardians beat Ego and dies saving Peter.
Nebula tries to kill Gamora, then makes peace with her and fights Ego beside the Guardians.
Nebula escapes Thanos and reaches Titan, where she fights him beside Tony and the Guardians.
Nebula joins the Time Heist, and when her 2014 self takes her place, she shoots that version dead.
Nebula helps save Rocket and stays on Knowhere to lead it and raise the rescued children.

k: Yondu's first mate in the Ravagers
st: Kraglin flies with Yondu's Ravagers in the battle against Ronan.
Kraglin helps Yondu take back his ship, then inherits Yondu's arrow.
Kraglin fires on the High Evolutionary's ship from Knowhere and joins Rocket's new team.

tm: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
st: Cosmo sits among the Collector's specimens on Knowhere.
Cosmo lives on Knowhere with the Guardians and helps them through Christmas.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Cosmo opens a telekinetic tunnel to save the captives and joins Rocket's new team.

k: A talking duck from another world
st: Freed from the Collector's museum, Howard the Duck sips a drink with Cosmo.
Howard the Duck fights in the final battle against Thanos's army.
In 1980, Meredith falls for Ego, who later admits he put the tumor in her head.
Dying of cancer in 1988, Meredith leaves Peter a gift and a mixtape.
In 1988, Peter's grandfather urges him to say goodbye to his dying mother.
Peter comes home to Earth and reunites with his grandfather.
Dey arrests the Guardians on Xandar, then helps them stop Ronan and clears their records.

k: Nova Prime, leader of the Nova Corps
st: Nova Prime leads the defense of Xandar against Ronan and trusts the Guardians' plan.
Saal leads the Nova pilots' blockade against Ronan's ship and dies when Ronan breaks through.
Mantis turns on Ego, helps the Guardians, and joins them.
Mantis calms Thanos on Titan, then turns to dust.
Restored, Mantis fights in the final battle.
Mantis plans a Christmas for Peter and tells him she is his half-sister.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Mantis helps save Rocket, then leaves to find her own path.

k: A Ravager leader and Yondu's old friend
st: Stakar casts out Yondu, then salutes him at his funeral and reunites his old team.
Stakar's Ravagers welcome Gamora back after the fight with the High Evolutionary.
Martinex rides with Stakar, salutes Yondu at his funeral, and rejoins Stakar's old team.
Martinex is among the Ravagers when Gamora returns to them.

k: A Kree warrior who lost her memories
tm: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: Kree warrior Vers crash-lands on Earth in 1995 and learns she is really Air Force pilot Carol Danvers.
Carol unlocks her full power, turns on the Kree, and leaves to help the Skrulls find a home.
Answering Fury's pager, Carol arrives at the Avengers Compound.
Carol brings Tony home from space, wrecks Thanos's ship, and fights in the final battle.
Carol joins Wong and Bruce by hologram to study the Ten Rings.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Carol suddenly swaps places with Kamala Khan.
Carol, Monica and Kamala swap places when they use their powers, and together they stop Dar-Benn.

k: Carol Danvers's best friend, an Air Force pilot
st: Maria tells Carol about her past, then flies beside her to help the Skrulls escape the Kree.
In 1995, young Monica urges her mother to fly with Carol against the Kree.
Back from the Blip, Monica enters the Westview Hex for S.W.O.R.D. and gains powers.
Monica's powers become linked with Carol's and Kamala's, and she ends up stranded in another universe.

k: A Flerken that looks like a cat
st: Goose swallows the Tesseract and scratches out Fury's eye.
Goose and her kittens swallow the crew of Fury's space station to save them.

k: A Kree scientist hiding on Earth as Dr. Lawson
st: Mar-Vell, posing as Dr. Wendy Lawson, is killed by Yon-Rogg in 1989 while protecting the Skrulls.

k: A Skrull leader and Fury's ally
st: Talos chases Carol, then reveals his people are refugees and becomes her ally.
Talos poses as Nick Fury on Earth while the real Fury is in space.
Talos works with Fury against Gravik's rebels, and Gravik kills him during an attack on the President.
Soren hides with the Skrull refugees until Carol helps them escape the Kree.
Soren poses as Maria Hill on Earth alongside Talos.
Talos tells their daughter G'iah that Gravik's rebels killed Soren.

k: A boy in Tennessee who helps Tony Stark
st: Harley helps a stranded Tony fix his armor in Tennessee, and Tony leaves him a new workshop.

k: An actor hired to play the Mandarin
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: Killian hires actor Trevor to play the Mandarin, and Tony exposes him.
In prison, Trevor enjoys his fame until the Ten Rings break him out to meet the real Mandarin.
Held by Wenwu for years, Trevor befriends Shang-Chi with his hundun Morris and helps him fight.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Spying on actor Simon Williams for Damage Control, Trevor becomes his friend, and Simon breaks him out of prison.

k: A veteran who flies as the Falcon
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
st: Veteran Sam Wilson befriends Steve and flies as the Falcon to help take down HYDRA.
Sam guards the Avengers Facility and loses a scrap to Scott Lang.
Sam sides with Steve, is locked in the Raft, and is broken out.
Sam fights Thanos's army in Wakanda and turns to dust.
Restored, Sam joins the final battle, and an old Steve hands him the shield.
Sam gives up the shield, fights the Flag Smashers with Bucky, then takes it up as Captain America.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
